tracking: ADR-0362 slice 1b-ii (lane E43): the brief is API and backend only; the project content-inspection settings card is for the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/projects/:projectId/content-insp: reads whether a project's attached files are inspected (stored setting, effective policy, compliance floor, cost note)
gaps.PUT /v1/projects/:projectId/content-insp: turns a project's content inspection on or off or chooses what an unreadable file does (relaxing is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
